verdicts.reasoning: Every stem in the set is about a clock time and nothing else — seed 57 keys 6:00, seed 64 keys 2:30, seed 11 targets 9:30 — with the payload carrying an explicit correct_time hour/minute pair each time.
Whole-hour times on the dot are present in both interaction modes: seed 57 reads 6:00 and seed 78 reads 2:00 off the clock (minute_angle 0.0), and seed 91 asks the pupil to set 10:00.
Half-past times occur as both a set task and a read task — seed 11 sets 9:30 and seed 23 sets 2:30, while seed 64 requires reading 2:30 against the near-miss distractor 2:25.
Quarter-past times are covered: seed 42 reads 2:15, seed 118 reads 11:15, and seed 103 asks the clock to be set to 8:15, each with minute_angle 90.0 for the quarter turn.
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Only the quarter-past case appears; quarter-to (e.g. :45) is absent from all ten samples, so half of the quarter-hour idea is untested here.

verdicts.reasoning: Every sample renders a ClockSet face with hand angles rather than a digital readout — seed 42 places the hour hand at 67.5 degrees for 2:15 and seed 11 at 285.0 degrees for 9:30, which is exactly the fractional hour-hand position an analog dial shows.
